reportBug.title: Report a bug
reportBug.description: Tell us what went wrong. We read the page you came from, your language and your browser along with it.
reportBug.attached: A copy of {{ name }} as it is now goes to the maintainers with this report, so we can see what you saw. Changing the character afterwards does not change the copy.
reportBug.shareHint: Untick to send the report without the character.
reportBug.descriptionHint: What you expected, and what happened instead.
reportBug.stepsHint: Optional. What you did before it happened.
reportBug.sentWithoutCharacter: Thanks. Your report was sent, but without the character: it could not be copied.
reportBug.failed: Could not send your report. Nothing was lost; try again.
reportBug.tooMany: You have sent a lot of reports this hour. Try again later.

bugReports.title: Bug reports
bugReports.description: What people have reported, newest first. Open one to read it, set where it stands and take its character.
bugReports.loadError: Could not load the bug reports.

bugReport.title: Bug report
bugReport.loadError: Could not load this bug report.
bugReport.characterHint: A frozen copy of the character as it was when the report was sent. Save it, then open it with Import on the characters page: it becomes a copy of your own.
bugReport.noCharacter: The reporter did not share a character.
